commentary.text: 90+12' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+11' Kevin Schade (Brentford) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
90+11' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
90+10' The corner is flicked onto Sepp van den Berg (Brentford), but his close-range header flies just over the bar.
90+10' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
90+9' Kevin Schade (Brentford) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Brentford.
90+5' Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+5' Michael Kayode (Brentford) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
90+5' A clever short pass gives Igor Thiago (Brentford) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
90+4' The foul by Kevin Schade (Brentford) was seen by Samuel Barrott who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
90+3' A substitution has been made. Ismaila Sarr is replaced by Evann Guessand (Crystal Palace).
90+2' Kevin Schade (Brentford) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the left post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
90+1' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
90' 10 additional min. will be played.
89' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
89' Today's match ends for Yegor Yarmolyuk who will be replaced by Josh Dasilva (Brentford).

88' 2 - 2 It's a goal! Dango Ouattara (Brentford) makes it 2:2. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Sepp van den Berg and planted his close-range header into the left side of the goal. Dean Henderson was helpless.
87' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
86' Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
85' The corner from Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) is intercepted by the defence.

84' Dean Henderson makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Dango Ouattara (Brentford) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the left side of the target. The ball goes behind for a corner. Brentford will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
83' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
82' Substitution. Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) on for Kristoffer Ajer.

82' Nice move, nice attempt! Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post.
81' The resulting corner from Jordan Henderson (Brentford) is cleared.
80' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
77' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
74' Chadi Riad just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) replaces him.
73' Chadi Riad (Crystal Palace) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
72' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) picks up a rebound, moves into space and fires a shot at goal from long range that rises sharply and goes high over the bar.
71' The ball is cleared after Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball has crossed the sideline. Crystal Palace are taking a throw-in.

70' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman. Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) sends a chip pass into the box, but Caoimhin Kelleher is quickest to intercept the ball.
63' A substitution has been made. Vitaly Janelt goes off and Jordan Henderson (Brentford) comes on.
63' Mathias Jensen goes off the pitch and Kevin Schade (Brentford) comes on.
62' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) takes the corner but it's cleared.
61' Here is a change. Jorgen Strand Larsen is going off and Oliver Glasner gives the last tactical orders to Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace).
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Maxence Lacroix departs the field of play to be replaced by Chris Richards (Crystal Palace).
61' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play. Brentford are awarded a corner kick.
60' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Dean Henderson, who smothers the ball.
59' Igor Thiago (Brentford) forces a pass into the box, but Dean Henderson is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
57' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
57' The attendance for today's match is 17213.
55' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul.

52' 1 - 2 Goal! Daniel Munoz sets up Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) for a shot on the edge of the box. He doesn't hit the cleanest of shots, but the ball somehow finds its way into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
49' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) is able to continue to play.
47' The game is interrupted now, Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
46' Yeremy Pino comes off the pitch to be replaced by Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace).
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

45+4' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. The referee blows his whistle, Brentford are awarded a corner kick.

45+4' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Caoimhin Kelleher!
45+2' Handball! A player from Brentford handled the ball.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' Igor Thiago (Brentford) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
40' 1 - 1 Dango Ouattara (Brentford) gets to the rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball inside the right post and makes it 1:1.
39' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a clever chip pass, but one of the defending players comes up with a timely interception.
38' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Dango Ouattara. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
37' Brentford fail to score from a corner as Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) leaps to collect the ball.

36' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Good work from Brentford as they win a corner.
35' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
33' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
33' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Crystal Palace) receives a pass on the edge of the box and attempts a lob as the keeper is off his line, but the effort crashes off the left post.
32' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
31' Igor Thiago (Brentford) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
28' Vitaly Janelt sends a lovely ball from the corner into the path of Dango Ouattara (Brentford), whose close-range header flashes just over the bar.
28' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
28' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Brentford.
27' Samuel Barrott couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) and blew his whistle.

23' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Caoimhin Kelleher!
22' The resulting corner from Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) is cleared by the defence.

22' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag and Crystal Palace will take a corner.
20' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) glances on a header from the corner sent into the near post, but his close-range effort is blocked by a defender.
20' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
20' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. Crystal Palace earn a corner.
19' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
19' Brentford can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
18' Igor Thiago (Brentford) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Brentford get a corner.
16' Crystal Palace take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
16' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only rattles the right post.
15' Igor Thiago (Brentford) commits a rough challenge and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
14' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Crystal Palace.

14' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Caoimhin Kelleher anticipates the shot and makes a decent save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Crystal Palace.
13' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
13' A quickly taken corner by Brentford.
12' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
6' 0 - 1 Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) steps up to take the penalty and leaves the keeper helpless with a low shot inside the left post.
6' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) is going to take the penalty!
5' The Crystal Palace players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

3' There's a break in play and referee Samuel Barrott must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Crystal Palace using VAR. This could be interesting!
2' PENALTY APPEAL after Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
2' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Crystal Palace will kick-off.
Samuel Barrott will supervise the game today.
